name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, January 17, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Cyber City 3D Base Form
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Joint Adjourned Regular meeting of December 14, 2017 and the Regular meeting held on December 20, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
November 2016 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Accept Notice of Completion for the 2017-17 Slurry Seal Project
ACTION: That the City Council approve the following:
1.
Accept the work performed by Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc. for the 2016-17 Slurry Seal Project; and
2.
Authorize the Director of Public Works to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $25,200.20 to Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc. 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the attached NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #7j
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
ESTABLISH A DATE AND TIME FOR THE ANNUAL STRATEGIC PLANNING WORKSHOP AND MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW ACTION: Staff recommends that Tuesday, February 28, 2017 be selected with the meeting starting at 4:00 p.m.; or select the one of the alternative dates below:
February 27, 2017 (Monday)
February 28, 2017 (Tuesday)
March 1, 2017 (Wednesday)
March 14, 2017 (Tuesday)
March 16, 2017 (Thursday)
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF REMOVAL AND/OR SALE OF THE BOX CAR AT THE RAILROAD MUSEUM ACTION: That the City Council provide staff with direction regarding the Box Car.
Item #9
10.
DISCUSSION OF EXTENDING THE PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSIONER TERMS TO EXPIRE IN JUNE.
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 7, 2017, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
